about_the_game:
If you simply can’t get enough apocalypse, the Supporter Pack is for you.

By becoming a supporter, you’re helping fuel the ongoing development of GUNTOUCHABLES and the glorious expansion of the wastelands. We’ve got big dreams for the future, and your support helps make them possible.

As a thank-you, you’ll receive a small set of prestigious in-game items to show off your impeccable taste in end-times fashion:

  • Exclusive Gala Outfits for all four characters - Because apocalypse deserves a little pageantry

  • A Supporter Badge on the main menu and your player portrait - wear it with pride!

  • And, of course, our eternal gratitude and heartfelt thanks. <3

Important note: By purchasing this DLC, you're first and foremost supporting the game and the teams at Game Swing (developers) and Ghost Ship (publishers). The shiny bits above? Just icing on the canned cake.

content_descriptors.notes:
Contains blood, gore and elements of body horror. The game features killing large amounts of monster-like mutants that will explode in guts and fluids.

The game features use of tobacco, alcohol and prescription medicine.
